_doc: Recovery pipeline instrument. Every recovery ATTEMPT is recorded with its outcome, earned one trial at a time by fetch -> source-verify -> extract -> round-trip -> rebuild. This REPLACES the forward-scan vocabulary metric (which over-counted: a forward scan cannot tell a genuine synonym gap from by-design composite-specificity). BLOCKED_BY_MATCHER entries, each carrying the exact source string vs the exact registered keyword, ARE the vocabulary measurement -- zero false positives, evidence not guesswork. Outcomes: RECOVERED | REFUSED_ON_SOURCE | BLOCKED_BY_MATCHER | BLOCKED_BY_ACCESS | NOT_FOUND | SCOPE_PENDING.

scoreboard.note: corrections are NOT systematically flattering: of 5 recoveries, 2 tightened and 3 weakened (1 lost significance, 2 moved toward null); 2 refused on source; 1 held on scope. Those percentages appear NOWHERE in the abstract (actual primary 16.7%/37.5% = 20/120 vs 45/120); the counts were back-computed from invented rates. Plus population is ACUTE not recurrent. Inference change WITHDRAWN.

prevention_trial_title_omits_outcome._doc: A category error, not a synonym gap: for a PREVENTION question, requiring the OUTCOME term in the title/conditions is structurally guaranteed to fail, because a prevention trial names the ENROLLED POPULATION (e.g. cardiac surgery), not the condition it prevents (AF). Distinct from vocabulary: no synonym expansion fixes it; the screening DESIGN must not key the population criterion on the prevented outcome.

confirmed.evidence: COCS "Colchicine in Cardiac Surgery" and Farzaneh "Post-CABG Arrhythmias" X2-excluded because population_any requires "atrial fibrillation"; enrolled population is cardiac-surgery patients, AF is the outcome

prevention_trial_title_omits_outcome.not_the_defect: HFpEF/HFrEF/CKD/COPD/coronary topics correctly key the population on the ENROLLED disease population, not the outcome -- a heuristic scan flags ~10 but most are correct; a clean count needs per-topic adjudication (population-is-outcome vs population-is-disease), NOT reported as a number per the no-noisy-instrument rule

top_level_frame._doc: THE THESIS AT FULL STRENGTH: nothing in this project is ground truth until source-verified -- not the published meta-analyses, not the external auditors, not our own missing-trial list, not us. Source verification catches over-claims at every level, and we now have instances at each. Five levels now, and the human relay is one of them -- which is exactly why source-verify-before-integrate is the only rule that holds when every layer can over-reach.
